rationale: No take has run yet, so wave 1 spreads four complete barrel rolls around the plan: a conservative low and slow take with a soft landing, a nominal take, a higher and faster take for extra clearance over the 1.3 m plants, and one that delays the tuck to change the rotation timing.

candidates.label: conservative low roll
candidates.why: Lowest arc that should still clear the 0.85 m shelf top; soft landing to keep head G well under 8.

candidates.label: nominal roll
candidates.why: The plan's layout as drawn: 3.5 m/s run-up, 3.6 m/s take-off, full 360 degree roll timed to the middle of the flight.

candidates.label: high fast roll
candidates.why: More height and speed for clearance over the tallest plants (top about 1.33 m); mat nudged 0.2 m out for the longer flight.

candidates.label: late tuck roll
candidates.why: Exploratory: keeps the body long over the shelf and tucks late to finish the roll before landing.
